name: v1.4.220
body:
Thank you so much for using Orca and for your continued support! ❤️

This patch is built from the October 2 daily build plus fixes picked from main. Pull requests that landed on main after that are not in this build.

## The short version

- **Native chat (experimental):** The **"Stop" button** ends Claude's process, including background commands and subagents. If Codex refuses or never answers a stop request, Orca ends it too. Unsent messages stay unsent until Retry, steered messages are not duplicated, and interrupted turns show a clearer status.
- **Chat polish:** `/clear` switches chats immediately; the first message starts the new agent. Codex connection retries update one warning instead of stacking errors. You can send AI notes to open chats, and older Orca versions preserve newer chat histories as read-only.
- **Agent status:** Esc cancellation settles Codex panes promptly, while Ctrl+C used to copy or leave `/side` no longer looks like an interruption. OpenCode shows failed and stopped turns correctly. Slow SSH connections no longer make agents look gone.
- **Usage meters:** Antigravity shows its own quota without Gemini CLI sign-in or spending quota to check. Cursor sign-in checks no longer freeze on large databases or mistake a refused usage request for an expired login.
- **Workspaces:** Creation is faster in large repositories, removal no longer stalls chat or files, and a workspace finishing in the background no longer switches your view. Local `main` updates are safer, and sidebar host tags can be hidden.
- **SSH hosts:** An optional Orca runtime works without Node, npm, or a compiler on the host; **Auto** remains the default. Standard Windows SSH accounts work, and keystrokes typed during terminal reconnection are kept.
- **Screenshot drops:** Mac screenshot thumbnails can now be dropped into a local Claude Code terminal or the new-workspace composer. Orca gives the agent a readable copy of the temporary image; previously, some drops looked successful but the screenshot never reached Claude Code.
- **Terminals and files:** macOS Option shortcuts reach terminal apps, background terminals return to their original tab, and wide paired-server panes use their full width. Huge Markdown previews no longer freeze Orca; review-note visibility and shell-file highlighting are fixed.
- **Stability and tools:** Orca recovers from several Linux and Windows crash loops and retries failed window launches. The first Windows browser command no longer hangs, the iOS simulator works with Xcode 27, and `orca file open` stays in your current view unless given `--focus`.

Terminals open before this update keep using the previous background service; new terminals use the new one.

## Known issues

**Windows on ARM:** The ARM64 package ships an x64 `orca.exe` command-line tool. Windows 11 on ARM runs it under emulation. Windows 10 on ARM can't run it, so the `orca` command does not work there (#24094).

**OpenCode 2:** OpenCode 2 panes that were already running before the update may show no status until you restart OpenCode in them. If you downgrade Orca after this update, duplicate OpenCode status plugins are left behind. After `opencode run` exits, its pane can keep showing "Done"; a fix is pending in #24472.

**Codex:** After you upgrade, Codex launches use Orca's managed Codex home until Codex approves Orca's new status hook. A resumed pane that uses `~/.codex` can pause for up to 30 seconds (#23552).

**Claude folder trust:** Folder pre-trust is on by default (Settings → Agents → "Trust the folder when Orca starts an agent"). On Alpine WSL, Orca can't copy the file permissions it needs, so Claude shows its own trust prompt instead (#23744).

---

## Product experience

### Native chat

*Experimental structured chats stop reliably, never send a message you were told was not sent, report crashed turns honestly, and keep their history when an older Orca opens them.*

* fix(claude): a Stop ends Claude's process, and the next message resumes the conversation by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/24235
* fix(native-chat): a Codex Stop that Codex refuses or never answers ends the Codex process by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/24334
* fix(native-chat): after a Stop whose exit can't be confirmed, the next message retries the stop instead of failing by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/24333
* fix(native-chat): Stop's pause is worked out from the chat's history, so a steered message is never re-sent by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/24072
* fix(native-chat): a message the chat said was not sent is never sent later on its own by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/24232
* fix(native-chat): a Stop still reads as yours after Orca restarts, because the turn's end reads the Stop's event by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/24311
* fix(agent-status): a turn a crash cut off reads Interrupted, an unproven end Couldn't confirm by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23467
* fix(claude): end a message Claude started but never confirmed, and keep Claude running while it holds one by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23898
* fix(codex): steer a mid-turn send into the running turn by name by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/21062
* fix(native-chat): every chat action press is its own action (re-land #23916 on main) by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/24301
* fix(native-chat): /clear starts nothing; the new chat's first message starts its agent by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23935
* fix(native-chat): chat failure messages appear in the app's language by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23674
* fix(native-chat): a Codex stream retry is one warning row that updates in place by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23684
* fix(native-chat): a failed Codex turn shows its error, not a raw thread-status row by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23704
* fix(claude): an informational note is a warning row in its own words, never a raw frame row by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/24471
* fix(native-chat): the working line shows only what the agent is doing now by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/24218
* fix(native-chat): a resting chat lists its model the way the running agent does, so no stray effort picker appears by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/24267
* feat(native-chat): the chat strip and the sidebar read the host's child records by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/22614
* feat(native-chat): register Codex default-mode helpers as subagents by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/22619
* fix(notes): send AI notes to open structured chat sessions by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/24221
* fix(native-chat): a paired server admits structured chat by client capability, not its own chat setting by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/24203
* fix(native-chat): an older Orca keeps a chat with a newer row kind read-only instead of deleting the rest of its history by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/24477
* fix(native-chat): a failed startup chat-lease save no longer puts the app into "Session restore failed" by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23964
* refactor(native-chat): keep agent-session records in the chat journal database by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/24006
* refactor(native-chat): structured chat failures always reach the diagnostics log by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/24312

### Codex & orchestration

*Codex panes settle when you cancel with Esc or press Ctrl+C to copy, orchestration finds Antigravity, Cline and Prime Agent ready, and chat agents can learn their own Orca session ID.*

* fix(codex): install Codex's Interrupt hook so an Esc-cancelled turn settles by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/24332
* Fix Codex status after Ctrl+C copy and side-chat navigation by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/24339
* feat(orchestration): tell each agent its own orchestration address by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/22636
* fix(orchestration): call the Orca session ID orca_session_id everywhere agents see it by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/24230
* fix(runtime): read Antigravity, Cline and Prime Agent readiness from the live screen by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/24222
* refactor(runtime): read four agents' readiness from JSON rule files through one engine by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/24348
* refactor(runtime): read Codex, Claude, OpenCode, Pi, OMP and Gemini readiness from rule files by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/24375
* fix(runtime): settle tui-idle on hook state for agents whose hooks cover the whole turn by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/24388
* fix(cli): orca file open no longer moves your view unless you pass --focus by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/24244

### Agents & agent integrations

*Antigravity and Cursor usage meters show real numbers, OpenCode shows failed and stopped turns, and agents are no longer marked as exited when Orca simply couldn't check.*

* fix(agent-status): preserve hook presence when process checks cannot answer (step 1 of 3) by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23947
* fix(opencode): preserve turn outcomes and avoid auto permission attention by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/24612
* fix(opencode): keep absent session stores quiet by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/24577
* fix(rate-limits): read real Antigravity quota from the agy CLI, not the Gemini mirror by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/24073
* fix(status-bar): show Antigravity's model-group pools instead of an empty segment by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/24074
* fix(antigravity): gate free quota reads by CLI version and usage preference by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/24593
* fix(antigravity): discover skills from the CLI global config directory by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/24592
* fix(antigravity): launch POSIX hooks through sh with bounded JSON stdin by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/24596
* fix(cursor): read desktop login outside the main thread by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/24572
* fix(cursor): distinguish usage failures from expired login by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/24575
* fix(cursor): preserve UTF-8 in Windows hook transport by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/24585
* fix(dsh): support 0.2 positional profiles and first workspace launch by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/24589
* fix(ai-vault): follow ZCode stored transcript order by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/24584

### Terminal

*Mac screenshot thumbnails now reach Claude Code when dropped into a local terminal or the new-workspace composer. Wide panes use their full width, Option shortcuts work on ABC keyboards, OpenCode tabs respond to clicks, and a background terminal returns to its own tab.*

* Fix terminal width cutoff on wide panes by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/24687
* Enable Option shortcuts for ABC keyboards in Auto mode by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/24528
* fix(terminal): pass single-pane OpenCode tab clicks through drag strip by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/24591
* fix(terminal): fill OpenCode DOM block glyphs in repainted rows by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/24582
* fix(terminal): reattach a background terminal to its own tab instead of opening a duplicate by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/24458
* fix(terminal): stop parking pass queueing no-op renders that trip React #185 during worktree removal by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23636
* fix(drop): make temporary Mac screenshots readable to Claude Code when dropped into a local terminal or new-workspace composer by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/24009

### SSH & remote hosts

*SSH hosts can run Orca on Orca's own Node so they need no Node, npm or compiler, Windows SSH hosts work for standard accounts, and typing during a reconnect is no longer lost.*

* feat(ssh): relay runtime fallback ladder, telemetry and host runtime setting by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/24133
* feat(ssh): opt-in SSH relay on the pinned Node with prebuilt addons by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/24129
* feat(ssh): pinned-Node relay on Windows SSH hosts by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/24135
* feat(ssh): rung B glibc 2.17 compat runtime; gate remote vault on host node:sqlite by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/24148
* feat(ssh): plain SSH terminals and SFTP browsing when no Orca runtime can run by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/24147
* feat(ssh): runtime-store GC in production and exec-stdin upload fallback by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/24136
* fix(ssh): collect relay versions only when provably exited; runtimes/ store GC by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/24130
* fix(ssh): Windows hosts without Add-Type staging; runtime-store GC on Windows by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/24149
* fix(ssh): launch the Windows relay outside sshd's job so standard users work by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/24224
* fix(ssh): keep keystrokes typed while a restored SSH terminal reattaches by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/24166
* fix(relay): treat EPIPE/ECONNRESET write failures as the client leaving by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/24209
* fix(ssh): name missing build tools when the relay has no node-pty by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/22670
* fix(ai-vault): require node:sqlite backup support in remote SQLite probes by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/24086
* feat(ai-vault): read remote OpenCode history with the pinned Node; remove Bun by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/24128
